text: Factor [Lat. facere , to make]: Ger. Factor ; Fr. facteur ; Ital. fattore . Any one of a plurality of causes or conditions which together determine a thing or event. Technical uses of the term are in mathematics, biology, aesthetics, &c.: see FACTORS OF EVOLUTION. ( J.M.B. )
